name: What is the typical timeline for ADU construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for ADU construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for ADU construction typically involves several phases. Design and permitting can take 3 to 6 months, depending on local planning department workloads and the complexity of the design. Actual construction usually ranges from 4 to 8 months, again varying with the ADU's size, type, and specific site conditions. Overall, homeowners can expect a total project duration from initial design to final completion of about 7 to 14 months. Unexpected site conditions or material delays can extend these estimates.
acceptedAnswer.description: Total ADU construction typically takes 7 to 14 months, including 3-6 months for design and permits, and 4-8 months for construction.
